criterion_as_frozen: Every distribution within |eps| <= 0.25 of predicted steps AND accuracy >= 0.99; Q3b retains a saving >= 1.3x at accuracy >= 0.99.
disclosure_before_scoring: The frozen record quoted idealised E[d] of 3.00 / 6.00 / 7.00 for easy / hard / narrow. The
distributions as actually sampled give 3.38 / 5.72 / 6.98. The prediction is stated as
'average steps = E[distance] + eps', so each distribution is scored against its own MEASURED
E[d], which is the reading most favourable to the prediction. Scoring against the idealised
values instead would only make the failure larger.
why_the_control_was_not_run: Q3b was specified to test whether the compute saving survives when the answer is decoupled
from the step count. That question is only meaningful if Q3 trains reliably in the first
place, and this run shows it does not. Running Q3b now would measure training reliability a
second time under a different name. The control is deferred to a separate prediction and the
artifact question -- whether answer = step count carried the Q3 result -- remains OPEN and
unresolved. No claim may be made in either direction.

observation: Accuracy, not step count, is what failed. For Q3 the halt step IS the answer, so accuracy
and steps are the same quantity measured two ways: a model that halts at the wrong step is
simultaneously inaccurate and off-prediction. Three of four cells did not learn the task at
all, which makes their step counts untestable rather than merely wrong.
immediate_diagnosis.first_hypothesis_tested: Task-construction artifact: chase_to_goal_weighted with uniform weights differs from chase_to_goal.
refuting_evidence: Re-running the ORIGINAL chase_to_goal at the ORIGINAL 500 training batches across seeds
0-4 reproduces the collapse: seed 0 gives 0.9994 at 4.54 steps, seed 2 gives 0.9998 at
4.54 steps, and seed 1 gives 0.4308 at 5.96 steps. The configuration that produced the
0.9995 headline fails on a different initialisation seed. See QNEURO3-Q3-VARIANCE-001.

what_this_costs_the_programme: The frozen distribution law is dead as stated and is not re-issued.
The Q3 headline (0.9995 accuracy at 4.53 steps, 1.77x less inference compute) is downgraded
from a result to a single favourable seed until the variance probe says otherwise.
The Q-Neuro 3.0 cycle-1 mechanism finding (mixture halting collapses, commit halting does
not) is NOT affected: that was an intervention on one variable with the seed held fixed, and
it is a statement about the mixture-vs-commit contrast, not about absolute attainment.
not_permitted_from_here: Re-issuing QNEURO3-Q3-P1 with a wider eps, a seed-averaged criterion, or an accuracy floor
Reporting the easy_skewed pass as partial confirmation. One cell out of four, and the easiest
one, is what a model that has only learned short chains produces by default.
Quoting any speedup figure for Q3 without the training-reliability rate attached.
